court: High Court of Judicature at Madras
case_name: Capt. M.S.Krishna Kumar vs Union Of India on 15 June, 2016

parties.respondent_defendant: Union Of India and others (Air India Limited, etc.)

facts_of_case: Petitioner is a check pilot seeking issuance of writ of mandamus to implement recommendations of grievance committee and restore his license.

legal_principles.principle: A person's conduct and behavior can affect their suitability for a role.
legal_principles.held: It is our firm opinion that Capt.M.S.Krishna Kumar cannot do justice as the Training Captain, as such it may be withdrawn from the date as informed by ED(Trg.).
cited_cases: Capt. M.S.Krishna Kumar vs Union Of India on 15 June, 2016

legal_principles.principle: A person's attitude towards authority and administrative protocol is important.
legal_principles.held: He has scant regard for the administrative protocol and does not respect the authority.
cited_cases: Capt. M.S.Krishna Kumar vs Union Of India on 15 June, 2016

legal_principles.principle: A person's vindictive nature can affect their suitability for a role.
legal_principles.held: He has vindictive nature towards his seniors in the base. Senior Pilots of his base have also alleged him of tampering official documents and also misuse of office stationary.
cited_cases: Capt. M.S.Krishna Kumar vs Union Of India on 15 June, 2016

legal_principles.principle: A person's knowledge and skills are important in a particular role.
legal_principles.held: It was found that the petitioner did not have adequate knowledge and abnormal check list and procedures thereof apart from not receptive to the counseling session.
cited_cases: Capt. M.S.Krishna Kumar vs Union Of India on 15 June, 2016

outcome.final_order: Court directs respondents to implement recommendations of grievance committee and restore petitioner's check pilot license.

use_for_drafting: drafting a writ petition for cheque bounce
seeking interim relief in a cheque bounce case
defending against a summary judgment in a cheque bounce matter
